The '''tee''' were large [[Scalefish/Legends|scalefish]] native to the oceans of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biology and appearance==
A standard tee was a rotund fish with bright-red scales, its fins relatively large to its body.<ref name="WSWFG" />

==Behavior==
Tee were known to be voracious hunters. They generally moved quite slowly, but were fast swimmers when chasing prey.<ref name="WSWFG" /> Outside the safer region of the [[Naboo Abyss/Legends|Naboo Abyss]], there were much larger specimens were known to have swallowed [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] whole.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Aside from [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], tee ate whatever they could catch and fit into their mouths, most often [[Mee/Legends|daggerts]].<ref name="WSWFG" /> Tee formed a symbiotic relationship with the smaller [[Laa/Legends|laa]], which would enter the tee's gills to clean off and eat parasitic [[Yobshrimp/Legends|yobshrimp]] that infested their bodies.<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
Tee were present in the waters of [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The tee, along with other musically-inspired scalefish, such as the [[Doo/Legends|doo]], [[Ray/Legends|ray]], [[Mee/Legends|mee]], [[Faa/Legends|faa]], [[See/Legends|see]] and [[Laa/Legends|laa]], were first introduced in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]<ref name="TPM" /> and associated media. It, along with other aquatic species of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], appeared in ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', where they were illustrated by [[Terryl Whitlatch]].<ref name="WSWFG" />
